worker_report.conclusion: The normal close_fds case completes its one session preparation and the exact queued GDBus flush: matching task/connection, queued FlushData, wait, matching gdbus-thread signal with finished=1, worker return true and termination state 2. It then enters controller.prepare_to_exec with the mapped callback and tracked exec context, but that exec coroutine never reaches state 2 or final notification before the original deadline. This selects the controller-reply await, not unfinished connection.flush or session disposal, in this run.

awaits.suboperations: Each BaseAgentSession.prepare_for_termination -> ScriptEngine.prepare_for_termination -> each ScriptInstance.prepare_for_termination; then connection.flush if connection exists.
awaits.native_states: Exec coroutine 0xbe3c: 0 begins termination, 1 resumes after termination, 2 resumes after controller reply.

awaits.completion_source: ScriptEngine instance loop completion. Loaded instances await dispose RPC completion; in a scriptless fixture no user script instance should need disposal, but the native observation must verify progression rather than assume it.
awaits.dependencies: If loaded, disposal can depend on gum-js-loop and RPC/message dispatch. Accepted fd 36 EBADF is relevant only if that path is actually entered.

awaits.completion_source: g_dbus_connection_flush makes GTask and schedules flush_in_thread_func in a pool thread. That function calls flush_sync, returns result/error into the GTask, then GTask completion dispatch invokes the awaiting callback in the initiating thread-default context.
awaits.producer_if_wait_required: _g_dbus_worker_flush_sync queues FlushData and waits while finished is false. flush_data_list_complete sets finished and signals its condition. It is reached by ostream_flush_cb or pending-flush cancellation handling on the shared gdbus worker.
awaits.important_fast_path: If no pending/in-flight writes and no unflushed messages exist, worker flush returns immediately; no condition signal is required.

awaits.completion_source: AgentController D-Bus method reply. Host resolves its agent entry, marks PROCESS_REPLACED, prepares exec transition, and starts wait_for_exec_and_deliver; the latter waits for actual exec and agent close before child delivery.
awaits.dependencies: Agent/host D-Bus transport and callback contexts must deliver request and reply. Absence of an EXEC child event alone cannot distinguish an unsent request, incomplete host method, lost reply or earlier flush wait.

event_loop_dependencies.role: Runs SpawnMonitor idle callback and Vala/GTask awaiting callbacks. Native IdleSource entry is proven, so it cannot be declared wholly undispatchable.

event_loop_dependencies.native_relation: fd 33 errno 9 is established. This does not by itself prove GTask starvation or identify the pending await.

event_loop_dependencies.role: Script execution/disposal when an instance exists.

descriptor_mechanism.fact: The kqueue backend puts poll registrations and EVFILT_USER wakeups on each context kqueue. Closing that descriptor invalidates both readiness and its wakeup channel. The wakeup helper does not repair a closed queue.
descriptor_mechanism.limit: Idle sources can still dispatch without a successful descriptor readiness result, as the native receipt demonstrates. A closed queue is not proof that every callback on that context is blocked. No descriptor ownership or close-call attribution is added by this read-only slice.

native_mapping.method: Exact embedded agent LC_FUNCTION_STARTS plus references to retained async task-name strings and cross-checked direct calls/helpers; private implementation names remain source inference, not recovered symbols.
native_mapping.state_qualification: Coroutine state is read from the first little-endian uint32 at x0 at coroutine entry. This layout is established by helper 0xc938 (mov x19,x0; ldr w8,[x0]) and state branches in the exact instructions. It must be revalidated on the live mapped image.

capture.exec_state: At 0xbe3c log x0 context and uint32 state: 0 initial, 1 termination resumed, 2 controller resumed.
capture.termination_state: At 0xa104 log x0 context/state: 0 initial loop, 1 session resumed, 2 flush resumed. For state 1 read session index at +0x80, count at +0x78 and session pointer +0x98; these offsets are instruction-derived. Do not interpret uninitialized fields on initial entry.
capture.session_begin: At 0x102e98 log x0 session, x2 callback, x3 parent context; correlate with termination state instead of treating every session return as the same await.
capture.controller_begin: At 0xe1edc log x0 controller, x1 info, x2 cancellable, x3 callback and x4 parent context; callback must equal base+0xbf64 and context match tracked exec coroutine. Helper 0xd080 establishes x2=null, x4=parent context before call.
capture.flush_begin: At 0x1658bc log x0 connection, x2 callback, x3 parent context. Track only callback equal to live base+0xa2b0 and a recorded termination context.
capture.flush_task_created: At 0x1658cc record returned x0 GTask, linked to matching entry thread and frame (entry SP minus 0x20, validated prologue), before run_in_thread can start.
capture.flush_worker_begin: At 0x165918 filter x0 equal to tracked GTask; log worker thread, connection x1 and task pointer.
capture.flush_queued: At 0x1721d8 on tracked worker thread log x20 FlushData and x21 worker before scheduling can signal it. Record condition address FlushData+8, finished uint32 +0x20, target message count +0x18.
capture.flush_wait: At 0x1721f0 log same flusher/worker and finished flag. This proves a wait branch was reached; completed no-pending fast paths need no signal.
capture.cond_signal: At 0x1cb3bc filter x0 equal to a tracked FlushData+8; record caller LR, thread, finished field and callback stack addresses. No target-side helper calls.
capture.flush_sync_return: At 0x165940 filter x19 tracked task; log x0 boolean return and worker thread. Separates unfinished producer from missing awaiting callback dispatch.
capture.all_complete: At 0x110820 stop and detach immediately before resuming; do not keep LLDB attached across exec.
